project_name: KnowMon AI - Unified Knowledge & Quality Intelligence Platform
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO + SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Tactical AI Control Center)

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing system with minimum internal container padding p-6 to p-8 to eliminate collision.
layout_and_grids.density: High Density Grid (MODE B) for analytics and interactions, Tetris Asymmetric Grid (MODE A) for knowledge hub and decision trees.

surface_strategies.tracing_beam: 1px gradient border highlight on active audio player or selected node in decision tree
surface_strategies.grid_borders: Subtle border-r border-b border-white/5 for data tables and rubric matrices
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat dark card #121721 with 1px border-white/10 hover:border-blue-500/40 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200

image_urls.usage_note: Use these high quality stock images for call center supervisor and agent profile avatars in leaderboards, coaching logs, and interactions.

dashboard.title: QA & Knowledge Intelligence Command Center
elements: Top Summary Bar with 4 Hero KPI Cards: Avg QA Score (e.g. 88.4%), AutoQA Evaluated interactions count, Compliance Flag Rate, CSAT Index
Sentiment Distribution Radar/Donut chart (Positive, Neutral, Urgent, High Risk)
Agent QA Leaderboard table with rank badges, compliance streak, handle time, and action button
KB Search & Usage Trends chart showing top searched SOPs and resolution deflection rates

interactions_analyzer.title: Omnichannel Call & Transcript AI Scorer
elements: Audio Waveform Scrubbing Player with timestamped transcript syncing
AI Rubric Evaluation Breakdown (Greeting, Verification, Empathy, SOP Adherence, Closing)
Compliance Auto-Fail & Red Flag Alert banner with exact timestamp links
AI Coaching Insights box with positive highlights and specific delta improvements
Upload Audio or Paste Transcript modal for real-time analysis

qa_forms_builder.title: Rubric & Compliance AutoQA Form Builder
elements: Drag & drop criteria list with customizable weights and scoring type (Binary / Scale 1-5)
Compliance Auto-Fail Trigger configuration (e.g., missed disclosure = instant fail)
Live Preview drawer testing the form against a sample transcript

coaching_sessions.title: Agent Coaching & Action Plan Hub
elements: 1-on-1 Coaching session scheduler and progress log
Action items checklist with target completion date and supervisor sign-off indicator
Linked interaction audio clips tied directly to coaching feedback

knowledge_base.title: Smart AI Knowledge Hub & SOP Finder
elements: Central 'Ask AI' Neural Search bar with auto-generated cited summaries
Visual how-to step guides with collapsible accordion instructions
Category side-nav (Billing, Technical Troubleshooting, Compliance SOPs, Refunds)

decision_tree_builder_runner.title: Cognitive Decision Tree Engine for Live Agents
elements: Interactive Tree Builder canvas with conditional branching nodes (If Customer says X -> Go to Step Y)
Live Agent Tree Runner: Interactive wizard mode with step-by-step guidance, decision buttons, and quick copy scripts

lms_training.title: LMS, Quizzes & Certification Center
elements: Interactive course catalog for agent onboarding and SOP updates
In-app quiz runner with instant score calculation, explanation badges, and completion certificates

admin_and_roles.title: User Management & Role-Based Access Control
elements: User matrix with role badges (Admin, QA Auditor, Team Lead, Agent)
Role permissions toggle panel and Clerk SSO status indicator

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) for components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Always set explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Maintain high contrast ratios for text on dark/light surfaces (APCA / WCAG AA).
Include Clerk SSO indicator and role switcher in header/sidebar for demo purposes.
Ensure responsive layout for mobile and desktop screens.
